name: 70448 · Mandeville, LA
findings: ZIP 70448 (Mandeville) has 87 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70448 (Mandeville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
